snippet.title: shapez 2 - 1.0 Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The full release of shapez 2 is coming very soon, with a whole new game mode, modding support, achievements, new visuals & much more. Out April 23rd, 2026.

shapez 2 on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2162800/shapez_2/
Learn more about the upcoming Manufacture Mode: https://youtu.be/-QqeLvr3w2k

Like and subscribe to our channel for more!
